title: Sordland/Turn07/A_AddressToTheNation
description: Address to the Nation speech for all branches. Anton Rayne speaks of the future and the upcoming elections.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian and I walked into my office..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian and I walked into my office in the Maroon Palace to make my Address to the Nation speech.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Let's do it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Let's do it."
entries.menuText: "Yes. Let's do it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Are you ready, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you ready, sir?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was unusually crowded today. Cam..."
entries.dialogueText: It was unusually crowded today. Cameras, lights and microphones were set in place and the crew was standing by, ready to start filming.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am always ready.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am always ready."
entries.menuText: "I am always ready."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I guess.""
entries.dialogueText: "I guess."
entries.menuText: "I guess."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Good. I think the crew is ready. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I think the crew is ready. As soon as you take your seat, we can go live."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm sure you are, sir. As soon as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you are, sir. As soon as you take your seat, we can go live. The crew is ready."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took my seat and rearranged my no..."
entries.dialogueText: I took my seat and rearranged my notes on the desk as a crew member powdered my face with a cotton puff.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After everybody was ready, the dire..."
entries.dialogueText: After everybody was ready, the director gave the sign to start filming. I looked directly into the camera.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Brothers and sisters...""
entries.dialogueText: "Brothers and sisters..."
entries.menuText: "Brothers and sisters..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My fellow Sords...""
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow Sords..."
entries.menuText: "My fellow Sords..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My fellow citizens...""
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow citizens..."
entries.menuText: "My fellow citizens..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am grateful to earn the honor of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful to earn the honor of finally modifying the Constitution of Tarquin Soll."
entries.menuText: "I am grateful to earn the honor of finally modifying the Constitution of Tarquin Soll."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd like to speak about our future..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to speak about our future, about a great historic effort to give the words 'freedom,' 'fairness,' and 'hope' new meaning and power."
entries.menuText: "I'd like to speak about our future, about a great historic effort to give the words 'freedom,' 'fairness,' and 'hope' new meaning and power."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am happy to have this opportunit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am happy to have this opportunity to talk to you about the changes we have undertaken in Sordland."
entries.menuText: "I am happy to have this opportunity to talk to you about the changes we have undertaken in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have reached a turning point in..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have reached a turning point in Sordland's history."
entries.menuText: "We have reached a turning point in Sordland's history."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am proud of what our government..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud of what our government has accomplished. We have finally brought fairness and balance to our once-decrepit system."
entries.menuText: "I am proud of what our government has accomplished. We have finally brought fairness and balance to our once-decrepit system."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Two years ago, I spoke to you of c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Two years ago, I spoke to you of change, and we have accomplished that."
entries.menuText: "Two years ago, I spoke to you of change, and we have accomplished that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We need to remember where Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to remember where Sordland was two years ago. Those days are behind us now, and the change we brought has been real."
entries.menuText: "We need to remember where Sordland was two years ago. Those days are behind us now, and the change we brought has been real."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But in another sense, our change i..."
entries.dialogueText: "But in another sense, our change is a continuation of that which started three decades ago with the fall of monarchy."
entries.menuText: "But in another sense, our change is a continuation of that which started three decades ago with the fall of monarchy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our new Constitution is a second r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our new Constitution is a second revolution in the history of Sordland that truly transforms the course of government with just one word: Democracy."
entries.menuText: "Our new Constitution is a second revolution in the history of Sordland that truly transforms the course of government with just one word: Democracy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The new system brings a more trans..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new system brings a more transparent democracy that will help Sordland rise up in the world."
entries.menuText: "The new system brings a more transparent democracy that will help Sordland rise up in the world."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For the sake of fairness, simplici..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the sake of fairness, simplicity, and growth, we had to radically change the structure of our government system."
entries.menuText: "For the sake of fairness, simplicity, and growth, we had to radically change the structure of our government system."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We made a Constitution that no lon..."
entries.dialogueText: "We made a Constitution that no longer protects the rights of a select few elites, but ensures the participation of all."
entries.menuText: "We made a Constitution that no longer protects the rights of a select few elites, but ensures the participation of all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We transformed a system that had c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We transformed a system that had caused endless confusion and resentment into one that is clear, simple, and fair for all."
entries.menuText: "We transformed a system that had caused endless confusion and resentment into one that is clear, simple, and fair for all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will not rest until every Sordi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will not rest until every Sordish citizen enjoys the freedom, dignity, and opportunity that is our birthright."
entries.menuText: "We will not rest until every Sordish citizen enjoys the freedom, dignity, and opportunity that is our birthright."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""With our reforms complete, our gov..."
entries.dialogueText: "With our reforms complete, our government will now focus on the economic development of Sordland."
entries.menuText: "With our reforms complete, our government will now focus on the economic development of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Now, we have other challenges ahea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, we have other challenges ahead. We will be focusing on Sordland's internal and external threats."
entries.menuText: "Now, we have our next challenges. We will be focusing on Sordland's internal and external threats."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paused to take a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: I paused to take a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Next, we must transition into the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Next, we must transition into the parliamentary system."
entries.menuText: "Next, we must transition into the parliamentary system."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Henceforth, our government shall n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Henceforth, our government shall no longer be able to obstruct the will of the people."
entries.menuText: "Henceforth, our government shall no longer be able to obstruct the will of the people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've spoken with and received lett..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've spoken with and received letters from thousands of you. I know how hungry you were for change. Make no mistake. Together, we can change Sordland forever."
entries.menuText: "I've spoken with and received letters from thousands of you. I know how hungry you were for change. Make no mistake. Together, we can change Sordland forever."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""By now I'm sure you have one quest..."
entries.dialogueText: "By now I'm sure you have one question on your minds: Will our reforms help you? You bet they will. We see them as the democratization of Sordland because they close loopholes that benefit a privileged few."
entries.menuText: "By now I'm sure you have one question on your minds: Will our reforms help you? You bet they will. We see them as the democratization of Sordland because they close loopholes that benefit a privileged few."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""New term limits will ensure that n..."
entries.dialogueText: "New term limits will ensure that no single person can block change when it's most needed."
entries.menuText: "New term limits will ensure that no single person can block change when it's most needed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We now ensure that neither I nor a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We now ensure that neither I nor any other person who holds the position of president will pose the risk of ruling by decree."
entries.menuText: "We now ensure that neither I nor any other person who holds the position of president will pose the risk of ruling by decree."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We eliminated the Supreme Court's..."
entries.dialogueText: "We eliminated the Supreme Court's iron grip on our legislation."
entries.menuText: "We eliminated the Supreme Court's iron grip on our legislation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A new age is upon us!""
entries.dialogueText: "A new age is upon us!"
entries.menuText: "A new age is upon us!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I stand proud to have exchanged my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand proud to have exchanged my own powers for a better future. Presidential decrees are now a thing of the past."
entries.menuText: "I stand proud to have exchanged my own powers for a better future. Presidential decrees are now a thing of the past."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will personally make sure that e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will personally make sure that every change is respected and executed properly."
entries.menuText: "I will personally make sure that every change is respected and executed properly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Beyond this, we intend to strength..."
entries.dialogueText: "Beyond this, we intend to strengthen the democratic freedoms of every Sordish citizen."
entries.menuText: "Beyond this, we intend to strengthen the democratic freedoms of every Sordish citizen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I must thank the Supreme Court Jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must thank the Supreme Court Justices for supporting these much-needed changes."
entries.menuText: "I must thank the Supreme Court Justices for supporting these much-needed changes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For too long, our Supreme Court ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "For too long, our Supreme Court has acted on behalf of sinister deep state interests. That ends from now on."
entries.menuText: "For too long, our Supreme Court has acted on behalf of sinister deep state interests. That ends from now on."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""By abolishing the position of Memb..."
entries.dialogueText: "By abolishing the position of Member of Honor, we have ensured that Sordland will no longer be a slave to its past."
entries.menuText: "By abolishing the position of Member of Honor, we have ensured that Sordland will no longer be a slave to its past."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I promise you. We will not stop.""
entries.dialogueText: "I promise you. We will not stop."
entries.menuText: "I promise you. We will not stop."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have also lowered our unfair el..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have also lowered our unfair election threshold. No longer will the voices of the minority be silenced."
entries.menuText: "We have also lowered our unfair election threshold. No longer will the voices of the minority be silenced."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We did all of this in a time of ec..."
entries.dialogueText: "We did all of this in a time of economic stress and despite heavy protests."
entries.menuText: "We did all of this in a time of economic stress and despite heavy protests."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Voices were raised saying that we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Voices were raised saying that we had to look to our past for greatness and glory. We proved, and will continue to prove them wrong."
entries.menuText: "Voices were raised saying that we had to look to our past for greatness and glory. We proved, and will continue to prove them wrong."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The new changes in our system have..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new changes in our system have planted the seeds for untold future successes."
entries.menuText: "The new changes in our system have planted the seeds for untold future successes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will open the way for Tarquin S..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will open the way for Tarquin Soll's trial. He must answer for the crimes committed during his decades-long rule."
entries.menuText: "We will open the way for Tarquin Soll's trial. He must answer for the crimes committed during his decades-long rule."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We are creating a nation once agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are creating a nation once again vibrant, robust, and alive."
entries.menuText: "We are creating a nation once again vibrant, robust, and alive."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But we, the present-day Sords, are..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we, the present-day Sords, are not given to looking backward. In this blessed land, there is always a better tomorrow."
entries.menuText: "But we, the present-day Sords, are not given to looking backward. In this blessed land, there is always a better tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is time to renew our faith in o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is time to renew our faith in our system."
entries.menuText: "It is time to renew our faith in our system."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fellow citizens of Sordland, let m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fellow citizens of Sordland, let me assure you, our nation is poised for greatness."
entries.menuText: "Fellow citizens of Sordland, let me assure you, our nation is poised for greatness."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Today, we must do what we know is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we must do what we know is right, and do it with all of our might."
entries.menuText: "Today, we must do what we know is right, and do it with all of our might."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let history say of us: these were..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let history say of us: these were the golden years when Sordish Democracy was reborn, when Sordland reached for her best."
entries.menuText: "Let history say of us: these were the golden years when Sordish Democracy was reborn, when Sordland reached for her best."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll remind you of the revolutiona..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll remind you of the revolutionary phrase: 'Morning will come, Victory is close.' I am now glad to say that morning has finally come."
entries.menuText: "I'll remind you of the revolutionary phrase: 'Morning will come, Victory is close.' I am now glad to say that morning has finally come."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will not let any of my fellow ci..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not let any of my fellow citizens down."
entries.menuText: "I will not let any of my fellow citizens down."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The United Sordland Party will kee..."
entries.dialogueText: "The United Sordland Party will keep fighting for a stronger and more united Sordland."
entries.menuText: "The United Sordland Party will keep fighting for a stronger and more united Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The future lies in the Socialist M..."
entries.dialogueText: "The future lies in the Socialist Movement of the East."
entries.menuText: "The future lies in the Socialist Movement of the East."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The future is in our hands.""
entries.dialogueText: "The future is in our hands."
entries.menuText: "The future is in our hands."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The future lies in the Democratic..."
entries.dialogueText: "The future lies in the Democratic Movement of the West."
entries.menuText: "The future lies in the Democratic Movement of the West."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must take lessons from the Male..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must take lessons from the Malenyevist revolution in United Contana."
entries.menuText: "We must take lessons from the Malenyevist revolution in United Contana."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland must slowly put more powe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland must slowly put more power in the hands of the working class, which capitalism formerly oppressed."
entries.menuText: "Sordland must slowly put more power in the hands of the working class, which capitalism formerly oppressed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must lead Sordland with democra..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must lead Sordland with democratic socialism."
entries.menuText: "We must lead Sordland with democratic socialism."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must take lessons from Arcasia'..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must take lessons from Arcasia's democracy."
entries.menuText: "We must take lessons from Arcasia's democracy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must keep striving for a fair a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must keep striving for a fair and transparent democracy in Sordland and abroad."
entries.menuText: "We must keep striving for a fair and transparent democracy in Sordland and abroad."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must lead Sordland with social..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must lead Sordland with social democracy."
entries.menuText: "We must lead Sordland with social democracy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took another deep breath. Lucian..."
entries.dialogueText: I took another deep breath. Lucian shooed a fly away from my forehead.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For a Sordland of wisdom that hono..."
entries.dialogueText: "For a Sordland of wisdom that honors the family, knowing that as the family goes, so goes our civilization."
entries.menuText: "For a Sordland of wisdom that honors the family, knowing that as the family goes, so goes our civilization."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For a Sordland of vision that sees..."
entries.dialogueText: "For a Sordland of vision that sees tomorrow's dreams in the learning and hard work we do today."
entries.menuText: "For a Sordland of vision that sees tomorrow's dreams in the learning and hard work we do today."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For a Sordland of courage whose se..."
entries.dialogueText: "For a Sordland of courage whose service men and women, even as I speak, proudly stand watch on the frontiers of freedom."
entries.menuText: "For a Sordland of courage whose servicemen and -women, even as I speak, proudly stand watch on the frontiers of freedom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let us begin by challenging our co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us begin by challenging our conventional wisdom."
entries.menuText: "Let us begin by challenging our conventional wisdom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have begun promisingly. But it'..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have begun promisingly. But it's only a beginning."
entries.menuText: "We have begun promisingly. But it's only a beginning."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We're not here to congratulate our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're not here to congratulate ourselves on what we have done, but to challenge ourselves to finish what has not yet been done."
entries.menuText: "We're not here to congratulate ourselves on what we have done, but to challenge ourselves to finish what has not yet been done."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."
entries.menuText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A'Morgna wes core! Vectern sis da!""
entries.dialogueText: "A'Morgna wes core! Vectern sis da!"
entries.menuText: "A'Morgna wes core! Vectern sis da!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""God Bless Sordland.""
entries.dialogueText: "God Bless Sordland."
entries.menuText: "God Bless Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I salute you all with respect.""
entries.dialogueText: "I salute you all with respect."
entries.menuText: "I salute you all with respect."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The director gave the cut signal, a..."
entries.dialogueText: The director gave the cut signal, and the cameraman stopped filming. My speech was finished.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd like to speak about our future..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to speak about our future, about a great historic effort to give the words 'unity' and 'hope' new meaning and power."
entries.menuText: "I'd like to speak about our future, about a great historic effort to give the words 'unity' and 'hope' new meaning and power."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The new system brings a stronger g..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new system brings a stronger government that will help Sordland rise up in the world."
entries.menuText: "The new system brings a stronger government that will help Sordland rise up in the world."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our new Constitution is a second r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our new Constitution is a second revolution in the history of Sordland that truly transforms the course of government with just one word: Power."
entries.menuText: "Our new Constitution is a second revolution in the history of Sordland that truly transforms the course of government with just one word: Power."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We made a Constitution that no lon..."
entries.dialogueText: "We made a Constitution that no longer protects the rights of a select few elites."
entries.menuText: "We made a Constitution that no longer protects the rights of a select few elites."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We transformed a system that had c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We transformed a system that had caused endless confusion and resentment into one that is clear, simple, and efficient."
entries.menuText: "We transformed a system that had caused endless confusion and resentment into one that is clear, simple, and efficient."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""By now I'm sure you have one quest..."
entries.dialogueText: "By now I'm sure you have one question on your minds: Will our reforms help you? You bet they will. We see them as a strengthening of our system because they ensure efficiency and justice."
entries.menuText: "By now I'm sure you have one question on your minds: Will our reforms help you? You bet they will. We see them as a strengthening of our system because they ensure efficiency and justice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Henceforth, our government shall n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Henceforth, our government shall no longer be able to obstruct the will of the people -- nor the will of the President."
entries.menuText: "Henceforth, our government shall no longer be able to obstruct the will of the people -- nor the will of the President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""With my new powers as president, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "With my new powers as president, I will do whatever it takes to transform this nation into a global superpower."
entries.menuText: "With my new powers as president, I will do whatever it takes to transform this nation into a global superpower."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let history say of us: these were..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let history say of us: these were the golden years when Sordland was reborn and reached for her best."
entries.menuText: "Let history say of us: these were the golden years when Sordland was reborn and reached for her best."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The future lies in the capitalism..."
entries.dialogueText: "The future lies in the capitalism of the West."
entries.menuText: "The future lies in the capitalism of the West."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The future lies in Sollism.""
entries.dialogueText: "The future lies in Sollism."
entries.menuText: "The future lies in Sollism."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd like to speak about the events..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to speak about the events of the past months, about a great historic effort to give the words 'unity' and 'hope' new meaning and power."
entries.menuText: "I'd like to speak about the events of the past months, about a great historic effort to give the words 'unity' and 'hope' new meaning and power."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd like to speak about the events..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to speak about the events of the past months, about a great historic effort to give the words 'freedom,' 'fairness,' and 'hope' new meaning and power."
entries.menuText: "I'd like to speak about the events of the past months, about a great historic effort to give the words 'freedom,' 'fairness,' and 'hope' new meaning and power."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I soared to election on the winds..."
entries.dialogueText: "I soared to election on the winds of change. Change that was desperately sought and called for by you, the people of Sordland."
entries.menuText: "I soared to election on the winds of change. Change that was desperately sought and called for by you, the people of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""From the moment I was sworn in, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "From the moment I was sworn in, I have done nothing but fight to achieve the change you demanded."
entries.menuText: "From the moment I was sworn in, I have done nothing but fight to achieve the change you demanded."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I took office with a plan. To dism..."
entries.dialogueText: "I took office with a plan. To dismantle Sordland's ancient government structure and replace it with one that met the needs of the country we are today."
entries.menuText: "I took office with a plan. To dismantle Sordland's ancient government structure and replace it with one that met the needs of the modern country we are today."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I began my term with one goal: To..."
entries.dialogueText: "I began my term with one goal: To transform Sordland into a modern democracy."
entries.menuText: "I began my term with one goal: To transform Sordland into a modern democracy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I began my term with one goal: To..."
entries.dialogueText: "I began my term with one goal: To transform Sordland into a global force to be reckoned with."
entries.menuText: "I began my term with one goal: To transform Sordland into a global force to be reckoned with."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""However, due to circumstances beyo..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, due to circumstances beyond my control, my plans were thwarted."
entries.menuText: "However, due to circumstances beyond my control, my plans were thwarted."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Alas, my vision was too grand for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alas, my vision was too grand for the narrow scope of our current Supreme Court."
entries.menuText: "Alas, my vision was too grand for the narrow scope of our current Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My ambition did not waver, even as..."
entries.dialogueText: "My ambition did not waver, even as forces within my own government conspired against me."
entries.menuText: "My ambition did not waver, even as forces within my own government conspired against me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Alas, my vision was too grand for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alas, my vision was too grand for the narrow scope of our current Assembly."
entries.menuText: "Alas, my vision was too grand for the narrow scope of our current Assembly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Justices could not conceive of..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Justices could not conceive of a Sordland in which they weren't free to engage in corruption and bribery, knowing nobody could remove them from office."
